Hi Elliot / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can align on the path to procurement and production. Highlights from the call and the draft: 

- Proposed target close date: 2026-05-20 (flexible, suggested cadence below)
- Key milestones:
  • POC environment & network setup (owner: BeaconPay eng lead / Redwood SE) — target: 2 weeks
  • Security questionnaire review (owner: BeaconPay security / Redwood security) — target: 1 week
  • Legal redlines & SOW finalization (owner: BeaconPay legal / Redwood legal) — target: 2 weeks
  • Final sign-off & procurement (owner: BeaconPay economic buyer) — target: 2026-05-20
- Dependencies: VPC peering, SOC 2 evidence access, and procurement PO lead time

Suggested RACI (draft):
- Economic buyer: Sarah Ortiz (R)
- Security owner: BeaconPay security lead (C) — please confirm person
- Legal owner: BeaconPay legal (A) / Redwood legal (C)
- Eng lead: Elliot Morgan (R) / Redwood SE (C)

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and legal contact (reply with names & emails).
2) Confirm whether the target close date 2026-05-20 is realistic for your procurement cycle.
3) If you’re okay, I’ll route an updated MAP (with dates and a short milestone RACI table) and propose a 30-minute check-in Friday to agree action owners.

Attachments: BeaconPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_template.docx (reference)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Looping in technical details and a short checklist for the MAP (attached: network-checklist.pdf). Key points: 

- POC environment: we can deliver a scoped POC within 10 business days after VPC peering and SSO access are confirmed.
- VPC peering + firewall rules: BeaconPay must open IP range and allow TLS 1.2+; ETA dependent on their infra team (I estimate 3 business days once we have their network contact).
- KV cache migration: negligible for a POC, but plan for a 1-week window for production data sync.
- Acceptance criteria (example): POC runs 10 concurrent sessions with <300ms median gen latency; test prompts provided by BeaconPay produce <5% regression vs baseline.

I will complete the checklist and send the final version by EOD Thursday.
